title: Advance Observe query windows on every refresh
description:
## Finding

Observe refreshes reuse a fixed historical end time instead of advancing the requested time window. Dashboards appear live while repeatedly querying stale data.

## Evidence at audited commit

`crates/gtui-app/src/engine.rs:78`.

## Implementation constraints

Represent relative/live windows separately from absolute historical ranges. Compute one consistent now per refresh cycle and make time controllable in tests.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Relative windows advance on every refresh while preserving configured duration.
- [ ] Absolute historical ranges remain fixed and do not drift.
- [ ] All panels in one refresh share the same start/end instant.
- [ ] Pause/resume, clock skew, and config reload behavior are defined.
- [ ] Fake-clock tests prove successive refresh ranges and historical immutability.

## Execution dependencies

Blocked by THE-184 (UNLANDED). Directly blocks THE-186.
